causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Conditions during the high-priced period saw demand up to 450 MW higher than forecast.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At around 11.50 am, Origin's Energy's Uranquinty unit three tripped.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A planned transmission network outage between Sydney West and Yass exacerbated the impact of the system normal constraint until midday, when the line was returned to service earlier than forecast.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: The market impact of this constraint was made significantly worse following rebidding by Delta Electricity⎯initially by shifting capacity into higher prices and then reducing its generator ramp rates and maximum availability.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: The reduction in the 'ramp down rate' at Mount Piper and the reduction in availability at Wallerawang had a significant impact on constraint management in the vicinity of these stations, and led to a significant change in dispatch and price outcomes.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: For the 12 pm to 3 pm trading intervals, combined import capability into New South Wales was up to 2200 MW lower than forecast twelve hours ahead and up to 1900 MW lower than forecast four hours ahead.

constraints_named.quote: The system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S bound for much of 7 December.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows across the Terranora and QNI interconnectors also decreased from 349 MW at 11 am (into New South Wales) to 244 MW into Queensland at 11.30 am.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: Flows across the Terranora and QNI interconnectors also decreased from 349 MW at 11 am (into New South Wales) to 244 MW into Queensland at 11.30 am.
